2026-10-23.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Fixed roof overhang collider behavior and added proper ColliderInfo to overhangs and frames, preventing incorrect collisions when building.
- Corrected the toast notification shown when rotating boat building blocks.
- Buildings no longer split when blocks are flipped; rotation and flip checks now account for final orientation, fixing mirrored stairs issues and the 10‑minute flip window reset bug.
- Demolish option now correctly requires building privilege and shows an informative toast when disabled.
- Enabled the Scrap King building skin in standalone mode.

### Tools & Item Balance
- Shears now yield 25% more wool, have 200% knife durability, and deal 50% less damage.

### World & Creatures
- Plants grown on boats remain visible while sailing by using dynamic renderers.
- Animals no longer automatically turn toward the player when petted, preventing them from getting stuck.

### Player Items & Skins
- First‑join bug fixed: spawned rocks and torches now use the selected skin instead of the default.

### Delivery Pod Vehicle
- DPV radial menu now shows Mount, Fuel, and Pickup; condition persists after pickup; acceleration speed doubled; fuel consumption reduced from 0.15 → 0.08 /s and idle fuel usage lowered.

2026-10-22.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Rotating and flipping now share a single pie‑menu slot (toggle with E/Q), and mirrored stair skins are available and can be baked via Tools > Building Blocks.

### Gameplay Changes
- Softcore mode now allows up to 6 players per team (up from 3) and disables the deployable corpse system.
- Spray cans no longer become unusable when you look away quickly.
- Sailing: the correct sail collider (raised or lowered) is now active after spawning, fixing sail behavior.
- Scrap King DLC: block import settings have been adjusted and foundation step movement colliders tweaked, improving building and movement interactions.

### User Interface
- The Quit button works correctly again.

### Lighting & Visuals
- Lamps on player boats stay lit when you move away from their activation point.
- Lights that are turned on beyond their culling distance no longer flash at full brightness before turning off.
